summary: Completed comprehensive UI regression testing after massive React structural refactor. Verified ZERO functional regressions across all 15 test scenarios covering Main Menu, Game Screen, HUD Bar, BuildToolbar (8 category tabs), Fences tab (shape selector & drag hint), Field Ops modal (3 tabs, 15 acquire cards), Staff modal (hire/fire), Finances modal, Species Database modal, Research modal, Scenario mode (4 cards, tracker with goals), and Save/Load functionality. All React components render correctly, all interactions work as expected, no console errors or React crashes detected.

performance_notes.details: Browser suggests setting willReadFrequently attribute on canvas context for performance optimization. This is a performance suggestion, not a functional bug.

passed_tests: Main Menu: park name input, mode selection (management/sandbox/scenarios), Begin Operations button, save list panel all render and work correctly
Sandbox game start: game canvas renders, HUD bar visible with park name, cash (◈9,999,999), guests (0), rating (2.5), weather chip (DAY, 00:00)
Tutorial overlay: appears on first run, skip button (data-testid='tutorial-skip-button') works correctly
HUD Bar: all elements present and functional - park name, cash value, guest count, rating, weather chip with label and clock
BuildToolbar: all 8 category tabs work (terrain, ground, water, flora, paths, fences, habitat, facilities) - all clickable and switch correctly

Fences tab: shape selector (LINE/RECTANGLE) present, fence tiers 1-4 buttons found, gate button found, remove button found, drag hint updates correctly when switching between LINE and RECTANGLE shapes
Field Ops modal: opens correctly, 15 acquire cards render, 3 tabs (ACQUIRE/EXPEDITIONS/CONTRACTS) all switch correctly, close button works
Staff modal: 3 hire cards (xenobiologist, biomedical, warden) render, hiring works and adds roster row, firing works and removes roster row, close button works
Finances modal: opens with income/expense ledger rows, net-today shows, ticket-price-slider area visible, close works
Species Database modal: opens with species list, selecting species shows detail panel, close button works
Research modal: opens and closes without errors
Save functionality: save button (hud-save-button) works, success toast appears ('Facility state archived to secure storage.')
Exit to menu: exit button (hud-exit-button) works, returns to main menu correctly
Scenario mode: mode-scenario selectable, 4 scenario cards render, starting scenario loads game with scenario-tracker visible showing 3 goals, tracker collapse toggle (scenario-tracker-toggle) works
Load save: 25 save slots found in save list, clicking save slot loads game correctly
Console errors: No React errors, no white screens, no crashes - only 2 minor Canvas2D performance warnings (not functional bugs)
